CITE CURVEMOLE

Citing the version used

The references below identify the latest stable release.

Cite the CurveMole version actually used in your analysis. The version DOI below identifies the latest stable release. For an earlier release or a beta, use the matching DOI in its GitHub release notes ↗; check the version number and repository tag.

01 / RESEARCH USING CURVEMOLE

Cite your software version

The reference below is for CurveMole 1.1.0. If you used another version, cite that release's own DOI.

Romi, S. (2026). CurveMole: Modular Scientific Curve Fitting (Version 1.1.0) [Computer software]. Zenodo.
Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23730744 ↗
Download BibTeX ↓
02 / IDENTIFICATION IN THE METHODS

Name the software you used

Data were analysed with CurveMole version 1.1.0 (RRID:SCR_029214).

The RRID identifies CurveMole across versions. Include the actual version and keep its DOI in your bibliography.

RRID:SCR_029214 ↗
03 / THE PROJECT IN GENERAL

Refer to CurveMole as a project

Use this reference when discussing the project across versions.

Romi, S. (2026). CurveMole: Modular Scientific Curve Fitting [Computer software]. Zenodo.
Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22113854 ↗

The Concept DOI follows the latest Zenodo archive, which may be a beta. For research results, use the exact version DOI above.
